United Kingdom / CITY EDIT

Ten cities to start with.

Compare the city guide ↗
01 / United Kingdom

London

London combines royal history and major museums with West End theatre and varied neighbourhoods.

Explore London ↗02 / United Kingdom

Edinburgh

Edinburgh contrasts the medieval lanes of its Old Town with the Georgian streets of its New Town.

Explore Edinburgh ↗03 / United Kingdom

Glasgow

Glasgow combines Victorian civic architecture with major art collections and a lively music scene.

Explore Glasgow ↗04 / United Kingdom

Manchester

Manchester's industrial heritage shapes a city known for football, music and creative neighbourhoods.

Explore Manchester ↗05 / United Kingdom

Liverpool

Liverpool connects its maritime waterfront with the musical legacy of the Beatles.

Explore Liverpool ↗06 / United Kingdom

York

York layers Roman and Viking history within medieval walls and narrow historic streets.

Explore York ↗07 / United Kingdom

Bath

Bath brings Roman bathing heritage and sweeping Georgian architecture together in a compact city.

Explore Bath ↗08 / United Kingdom

Bristol

Bristol combines a historic harbour with engineering landmarks and a strong street-art culture.

Explore Bristol ↗09 / United Kingdom

Cardiff

Cardiff pairs a central castle and Victorian shopping arcades with a redeveloped waterfront.

Explore Cardiff ↗10 / United Kingdom

Belfast

Belfast links its shipbuilding heritage with Victorian landmarks and the cultural venues of the Cathedral Quarter.
